breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant, computing Tint,1 = +50000 N·mm for segment 0→800 mm and Tint,2 = −200000 N·mm for segment 800→1200 mm. This directly contradicts the flawed instruction in the incomplete prompt that said to 'take a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of the applied torques over the full length.' The generated specification correctly applies equilibrium segment by segment, matching the ground truth approach.
